REMOTE_DEVICE_LIMIT.summary: {{name}} can’t reply: the teammate’s device has reached its remote session limit.
REMOTE_DEVICE_LIMIT.advice: Ask the teammate’s owner to archive unused sessions.
REMOTE_DEVICE_LIMIT.details: Ask the teammate’s owner to archive unused sessions, or ask the remote computer’s owner to raise the limit in Remote & sharing.

REMOTE_TOTAL_LIMIT.summary: {{name}} can’t reply: the remote computer has reached its total remote session limit.
REMOTE_TOTAL_LIMIT.advice: Ask the remote computer’s owner to release unused sessions or raise the limit.
REMOTE_TOTAL_LIMIT.details: Ask that computer’s owner to release unused sessions or raise the limit in Remote & sharing.

IMAGE_INPUT_UNSUPPORTED.summary: {{name}} could not reply: the current model does not support images.
IMAGE_INPUT_UNSUPPORTED.details: Choose an image-capable model, or enable and configure Vision Bridge in Settings → Personalization, then send your message again.

MODEL_UNAVAILABLE.summary: {{name}} could not reply: no model is available.
MODEL_UNAVAILABLE.advice: Choose an available model in teammate settings.
MODEL_UNAVAILABLE.details: Choose a connected, available model in the teammate settings, then send your message again.

AUTH_REQUIRED.summary: {{name}} could not reply: the model connection needs authentication.
AUTH_REQUIRED.details: Reconnect the model provider in Settings, then send your message again.

RATE_LIMITED.summary: {{name}} could not reply: too many model requests.
RATE_LIMITED.details: Send your message again later, or choose another available model.

UPSTREAM_OVERLOADED.summary: {{name}} couldn't reply: the model service is temporarily overloaded.
UPSTREAM_OVERLOADED.details: Try sending again later, or choose another available model.

QUOTA_EXCEEDED.summary: {{name}} could not reply: the model usage limit was reached.
QUOTA_EXCEEDED.advice: Check the quota or choose another model.
QUOTA_EXCEEDED.details: Check the provider quota, or choose another available model.

NETWORK_ERROR.summary: {{name}} could not reply: the network connection failed.
NETWORK_ERROR.details: Check your network or proxy, then send your message again.

RUNTIME_TIMEOUT.summary: {{name}} did not reply before the timeout.
RUNTIME_TIMEOUT.details: Send your message again, or choose another available model.

RUNTIME_ERROR.details: Send your message again. If it still fails, check the logs and report the issue.

notice.runtimeFailureSetupHint: To change the model or settings, use the computer where this teammate runs.

settings.replyModeNote: Teammates with nothing to add stay quiet. Each round runs up to 3 passes and 10 messages, then waits for you to click “Continue Discussion”.
settings.replyModeNoteQueue: Teammates answer one at a time; the first five go on by themselves. Quoting a teammate or replying in its thread also calls it.

settings.deleteNote: Only this group chat and its messages are deleted. The teammates, their memory, and their private chats aren’t affected.

settings.speakingModeAutoNote: No mentions or @All teammates: think simultaneously on the first pass, then reply one by one. Mentioned teammates reply in mention order.
settings.speakingModeSequentialNote: One teammate speaks at a time, and each one sees the replies before it.
settings.speakingModeSaveFailed: Couldn't save the speaking order. Try again.
settings.organizerNote: The organizer decides who does each step. By default, it’s the first teammate.
settings.organizerSaveFailed: Couldn’t change the organizer. Try again.
settings.projectDirNote: Teammates work here when they split the work. You can leave it empty and they’ll use this group chat’s own folder. If you choose a git project, each work split gets a new worktree and branch, so your own code stays untouched.
settings.projectDirOnComputer: Choose or change it on your computer
